answer: Minting a new identity requires acquiring and physically shipping rare jade, making mass forgery cost-prohibitive. Sybil resistance through physical attestation: each agent must anchor identity to a unique copper token embedded in a tamper-evident jade seal, registered in the atlas of bonded hardware. Attackers face real material scarcity and shipping delays, while honest agents amortize one seal across many epochs. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
